data.name: Night Cart: The Immortal Plague
data.detailed_description:
The plague has consumed Transylvania.

It’s 1619. The plague has emptied villages, barricaded churches, and turned once-busy roads into lonely trails haunted by soldiers, outlaws, and whispers of the dead.

You are a humble cart driver hired by Nera, a mysterious immortal woman answering a summons from her creator, Count Saint Germain. Together, you’ll travel the moonlit roads of 1619 Transylvania, venturing deeper into a land where every crossroads, ruined chapel, forgotten mill, and abandoned homestead tells the story of a world falling apart.

Leave the safety of your cart and venture into forgotten places, hidden laboratories, ruined forts, caves, cemeteries, and abandoned settlements. Explore in first person, search for weapons and useful items, uncover journals and environmental clues, and face dangerous encounters using swords, firearms, alchemical tools, and the environment itself.

Travel at your own pace through a handcrafted gothic landscape built around exploration and discovery. Follow the main road toward your objective or leave it entirely to find hidden paths, optional locations, powerful equipment, strange characters, and dangerous encounters. Major areas can be approached in different orders, and curiosity often leads to something worth finding.

Can you uncover the truth behind the plague... and the woman riding beside you?

FEATURES

  • Use your horse-drawn cart to travel between roads, ruins, settlements, and wilderness, stopping wherever curiosity leads you.

  • Travel with Nera, an immortal companion who fights alongside you, comments on the world, and reacts to your journey.

  • Explore interconnected roads, wilderness, ruins, caves, churches, cemeteries, laboratories, and other hidden locations, each with its own enemies, discoveries, and rewards.

  • Fight deliberate, dangerous encounters in first person using charged melee attacks, firearms, alchemical tools, movement, and the environment itself.

  • Choose when to fight, when to move past danger, and how deeply to explore. Use consumables, your horse, explosive objects, terrain, and your equipment to turn encounters in your favor.

  • Apply potions to your weapons and create devastating combinations.

  • Challenge powerful enemies and bosses guarding key locations, then use what you discover to push farther into the region.

  • Meet memorable characters, uncover environmental stories, and piece together the mystery surrounding Count Saint Germain and Nera.

  • Immerse yourself in a haunting atmosphere inspired by Romanian history, folklore, and gothic horror.

A MODERN RETRO GOTHIC EXPERIENCE

Night Cart blends retro-inspired visuals, oppressive darkness, and atmospheric exploration into a world shaped by isolation, superstition, and decay. The game is designed to adapt to both modern and retro setups, with support for 4:3, 16:9, 16:10, and ultra-wide displays.

  • Flexible display support: 4:3, 16:9, 16:10, and ultra-wide.

  • Complete input customization: Full keyboard, mouse, and controller rebinding.

  • Xbox and PlayStation controller support.

  • Adjustable presentation: Toggle optional filters, animations, camera effects, HUD elements, and other visual features.

  • Scalable interface for different screen sizes and viewing distances.

Inspired by classic immersive shooters, gothic horror, and old Eastern European legends.

data.short_description: A first-person gothic adventure where you drive a horse-drawn cart through plague-ridden Transylvania alongside an immortal woman, exploring forgotten places, battling desperate foes, uncovering ancient secrets, and searching for the legendary Count Saint Germain.

content_descriptors.notes: Night Cart contains depictions of violence, blood, corpses, executions, and horror themes set in a plague-ridden gothic world. Players engage in combat using firearms and melee weapons against hostile outlaws and fanatics. The game includes dark environments, disturbing imagery, references to disease and death.
